estimation-unit.name: screen-changed-ui-components-complexity-base-value
estimation-unit.description: Multiplier for the accumulated extra complexity score of UI components with changes between classic UI and Flow UI. The score sum of all changed components found in a screen descriptor is multiplied by this value. Units: multiplier (1 = use per-component scores as is)

estimation-unit.name: screen-descriptor-extends-screen-complexity-score
estimation-unit.description: Additional screen complexity score value for the case when screen descriptor extends another screen. Units: screen complexity score

estimation-unit.name: screen-descriptor-has-nested-data-item-complexity-score
estimation-unit.description: Additional screen complexity score for each nested data container. The Flow UI data section keeps the same structure, so the weight is lower than in the CUBA profile. Units: screen complexity score

estimation-unit.name: screen-descriptor-ui-component-create-call-complexity-score
estimation-unit.description: Additional screen complexity score for each uiComponents.create() call within screen controller class. Units: screen complexity score

estimation-unit.name: initial-migration-cost
estimation-unit.description: Base cost of the platform migration: Gradle and Spring Boot upgrade, Vaadin plugin setup, main and login views regeneration, Liquibase adjustments. Units: hours

estimation-unit.name: security-role-cost
estimation-unit.description: Cost of reworking one annotated role (screen policies become view policies, package changes). Units: hours per role

estimation-unit.name: config-migration-cost
estimation-unit.description: Flat cost of configuration migration (renamed properties, menu rework, changelog includes), applied when the analyzer finds anything to rename. Units: hours

estimation-unit.name: custom-theme-cost
estimation-unit.description: Cost of recreating one custom SCSS theme as CSS customization on top of the Lumo theme. The value is a rough placeholder: deep theme customizations must be estimated manually. Units: hours per theme

estimation-unit.name: jakarta-sweep-cost
estimation-unit.description: Threshold estimation for the javax to jakarta namespace sweep. Input threshold value units: number of files importing javax.persistence/validation/annotation. Output value units: hours. The sweep is mechanical and mostly automated.

estimation-unit.name: screen-controller-method-calls
estimation-unit.description: Threshold estimations for amount of method calls performed within screen controller class. Input threshold value units: amount of method calls. Output value units: screen complexity score.

estimation-unit.name: screen-complexity-time-estimation
estimation-unit.description: Threshold estimation for screen complexity score. Input threshold value units: screen complexity score. Output value units: hours
